text:
sam: hitting a 400 from the /rerank endpoint when I copy the console cURL example from the docs. Error says \"invalid input\" but payload looks right to me. anyone seen this?

lina: can you paste the exact curl you ran + shell (mac/linux/windows)? most curl quoting issues show up differently per shell.

sam: macOS zsh. here is verbatim: 
```\ncurl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \\"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\\" \
  -H \\"Content-Type: application/json\\" \
  -d '{"query":"best laptop", "items":[{"id":"1","text":"macbook pro"},{"id":"2","text":"dell xps"}]}'\n```

michael: I think the docs example used -d with single quotes which looks fine on zsh, but our console button produces a --data-raw snippet with unescaped double quotes in some browsers which confuses people. Also note: the rerank input schema changed last quarter — the field name is `query` (singular) and `items` is expected to be an array of objects with `id` and `text`. If you accidentally send `queries` or a top-level `inputs` field the server accepts the request but returns a 400 or sometimes scores of 0.

sam: ok that explains the 0 scores I saw earlier. weird thing: I compared the docs console sample and the CLI snippet; they use slightly different top-level keys. opened the network panel and saw console snippet send: 
```\n{"inputs": [{"query":"best laptop","candidates":[{"text":"macbook pro","id":"1"}]}]}\n```
which our service ignores for the rerank route.

lina: thanks for the repro. can you share the full response body for the 400? quick check: is Content-Type exactly application/json? sometimes people paste the curl into Windows cmd and don't escape quotes, which yields malformed JSON.

sam: response: 
```\n{\n  \"error\":\"invalid_input\",\n  \"message\":\"missing required field: query\"\n}\n```

michael: yep that confirms it. docs-team recently shipped two variants of examples (console + CLI) and the console variant got updated for a batch-mode API change, whereas the CLI example stayed with the single-query format. This caused the mismatch.

docs-bot: created internal docs issue DOCS-1229 to reconcile examples. assigned to @lina.

support-bot: created ticket S-98765 for customer sam; set priority P2 and linked to DOCS-1229. next steps: provide sam a working curl and ask if they want us to backfill an automated migration to the new schema.

lina: temporary workaround for you, sam — use this exact curl (zsh):
```\ncurl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  --data-raw '{"query":"best laptop","items":[{"id":"1","text":"macbook pro"},{"id":"2","text":"dell xps"}]}'\n```

sam: confirmed that works, thanks. can we also add a note in the docs about Windows/cmd escaping and the console button consistency? a lot of customers will copy-paste.

lina: filing a short "copy-paste gotchas" section in DOCS-1229. will also add a runnable Postman/Insomnia snippet and a Powershell example.

michael: fyi, also adding server-side validation to return a clearer error when `inputs` or `queries` are present but not `query` to avoid silent failures in the future.

sam: great, appreciated. :thumbsup:
